name: Test Reader Four
text: We wear orange on Day 1 every year. Nice to see the 11 October date confirmed.

name: Test Reader Five
text: Does Day 1 start on the same date in Canada?

replies.name: Prashant Dhingra
replies.text: For 2026, North American calendars also list Day 1 on Sunday 11 October. Ghatasthapana time is local, so check a panchang for your city.
